IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  CRIMINAL REVISION APPLICATION (AGAINST CONVICTION - FOOD  ADULTRATION ACT) NO. 104 of 2017

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
============================================================
 ====
 PATEL RAJENDRA VALAMJI....Applicant(s)
 Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT....Respondent(s)
 ================================================================
 Appearance:
 MR IMRAN H PATHAN, ADVOCATE for the Applicant(s) No. 1  MS. MONALI BHATT, APP, for the Respondent(s) No. 1  ===============================================================
Ms. Monali Bhatt, learned Additional Public Prosecutor waives service of notice of rule on behalf of respondent State.

[2] In the present Criminal Revision Application, the applicant herein original accused has prayed to release him on bail by suspending the sentence imposed vide judgment and order dated 12.12.2013 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Fatehpura, in Criminal Case No.1668 of 2011,
which is confirmed by learned 4th (ad-Hoc) Additional District Judge, Dahod in Criminal Appeal No.1 of 2014, whereby the applicant has been convicted for the offence punishable under Section 16(1)(A)(ii) of the Act for the breach of Section 7(3)(5) of the Act and Rules 50(1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules, 1954
and sentenced to undergo simple imprisonment of one year with fine of 1000/- and in default, to undergo further period of one month simple imprisonment

[3]
Heard learned advocate appearing for the applicant and HC-NIC Page 1 of 3 Created On Wed Feb 08 03:22:37 IST 2017 R/CR.RA/104/2017 ORDER learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent State.
[4] Learned advocate for the applicant submits that the learned trial Court granted bail and the said period would expire on 09.02.2017.
He then contended that the learned trial Court awarded short sentence to the applicant and herefore, prays to release the applicant on bail.

[5] Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and sentence imposed by the learned trial Judge, the applicant is required to be released on bail and by suspending the sentence imposed Patel Rajendra Valamji vs State Of Gujarat on 7 February, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/112068293/

Fatehpura, in Criminal Case No.1668 of 2011, which is confirmed by learned 4th (ad-Hoc)
Additional District Judge, Dahod in Criminal Appeal No.1 of 2014, pending hearing and final disposal of the Criminal Revision Application.
